epilogue_apocalypse.title: Incomplete ashes
epilogue_apocalypse.blurb: Flight to the sky — the apocalypse grew honest, but the axis still descended into magma.

epilogue_depths.title: Depths of the axis
epilogue_depths.blurb: Another fold of stone — a deeper stratum, silence under a different name.

epilogue_true_depths.title: True depths
epilogue_true_depths.blurb: The Magma Lord fell; the floor of the axis closed under your name.

frost_epilogue.title: Frost epilogue
frost_epilogue.blurb: Vetrnax fell; under the ice, the Third Bell learns a new name.

epilogue_mirror.title: Broken mirror
epilogue_mirror.blurb: The fractured nave stays with you like a cut in the palm; you chose how to tell the pulse.

passage_graywind_heights.title: Passage to the axis floor
passage_graywind_heights.blurb: Beyond the throne, a fork: ice above or magma below — the axis still asks who rules the silence.
